title: An etale polynomial chart clears the diagonal kernel
statement: Let $R$ and $A$ be commutative rings, let $d\in\mathbf N$, and let $\psi:R[X_0,\ldots,X_{d-1}]\to A$ be an etale $R$-algebra homomorphism (its map of affine spectra is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]). Write $\mu:A\otimes_R A\to A$ for multiplication and $r_i=1\otimes\psi(X_i)-\psi(X_i)\otimes1$. There exists $e\in A\otimes_R A$ with $\mu(e)=1$ such that $e\cdot\ker(\mu)$ is contained in the ideal $(r_0,\ldots,r_{d-1})$.
